name: Barbell Bench Press
description: Lying on a flat bench, lower a barbell to mid-chest and press it back up to full lockout.

name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
description: Bench press performed on a 30-45 degree incline bench to emphasize the upper chest.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
description: Flat bench press with dumbbells, allowing a deeper stretch and independent arm movement.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
description: Dumbbell press on an incline bench targeting the clavicular head of the pecs.

name: Dumbbell Fly
description: Lying on a bench, open the arms wide with a slight elbow bend and squeeze the dumbbells together over the chest.

name: Cable Crossover
description: Standing between two cable stacks, draw the handles together in a hugging arc across the chest.

name: Push-Up
description: Classic bodyweight press from a plank position, lowering the chest to the floor and pressing back up.

name: Weighted Dip
description: Dips on parallel bars with added weight, torso leaned forward to load the lower chest.

name: Machine Chest Press
description: Seated pressing machine that guides the bar path, ideal for controlled overload.

name: Pec Deck
description: Seated machine fly bringing padded levers or handles together in front of the chest.

name: Conventional Deadlift
description: Lift a loaded barbell from the floor to a standing lockout with a hip hinge, keeping the bar close to the body.

name: Barbell Row
description: Hinged at the hips, row a barbell to the lower ribcage, squeezing the shoulder blades together.

name: Pull-Up
description: Hanging from a bar with an overhand grip, pull the chin over the bar with control.

name: Chin-Up
description: Pull-up variant with an underhand grip, shifting emphasis toward the biceps and lower lats.

name: Lat Pulldown
description: Seated cable pulldown to the upper chest with a wide grip, driving the elbows down and back.

name: Seated Cable Row
description: Seated row pulling a cable handle to the stomach while keeping the torso upright.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
description: Braced on a bench, row a dumbbell to the hip one side at a time for a full lat stretch.

name: T-Bar Row
description: Row a landmine-anchored bar with a neutral close grip, loading the mid-back.

name: Pendlay Row
description: Strict barbell row from a dead stop on the floor each rep, torso parallel to the ground.

name: Rack Pull
description: Partial deadlift from knee height in a rack, overloading the upper back and lockout.

name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
description: With straight arms, sweep a cable bar from overhead down to the thighs to isolate the lats.

name: Inverted Row
description: Bodyweight row under a fixed bar, keeping the body rigid and pulling the chest to the bar.

name: Overhead Press
description: Standing strict press of a barbell from the collarbone to overhead lockout.

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
description: Seated press of two dumbbells from shoulder height to overhead.

name: Push Press
description: Overhead press with a shallow leg drive to launch the bar past the sticking point.

name: Lateral Raise
description: Raise dumbbells out to the sides to shoulder height with a slight elbow bend.

name: Front Raise
description: Raise a dumbbell or plate straight in front of the body to shoulder height.

name: Rear Delt Fly
description: Hinged forward, raise dumbbells out to the sides to target the rear deltoids.

name: Face Pull
description: Pull a rope cable attachment toward the face with elbows high, externally rotating at the end.

name: Arnold Press
description: Dumbbell press that rotates from palms-facing-you to palms-forward through the range of motion.

name: Upright Row
description: Pull a barbell or cable vertically along the body to chest height with elbows leading.

name: Barbell Shrug
description: Holding a barbell at arm's length, elevate the shoulders straight up toward the ears.

name: Barbell Curl
description: Standing curl of a straight barbell with elbows pinned at the sides.

name: Dumbbell Curl
description: Alternating or simultaneous dumbbell curls with a supinated grip.

name: Hammer Curl
description: Dumbbell curl with a neutral (thumbs-up) grip, hitting the brachialis and forearms.

name: Preacher Curl
description: Curl performed with the upper arms braced on a preacher bench pad, removing momentum.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
description: Curl while seated back on an incline bench so the arms hang behind the torso for a long stretch.

name: Cable Curl
description: Curl against a low cable for constant tension through the full range.

name: Concentration Curl
description: Seated single-arm curl with the elbow braced against the inner thigh.

name: EZ Bar Curl
description: Curl with an angled EZ bar grip that reduces wrist strain versus a straight bar.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
description: Bench press with hands shoulder-width apart, shifting the load onto the triceps.

name: Triceps Pushdown
description: Press a cable bar or rope from chest height to full elbow extension, elbows pinned.

name: Overhead Triceps Extension
description: Lower a dumbbell or rope behind the head and extend back to overhead lockout.

name: Skull Crusher
description: Lying triceps extension lowering an EZ bar to the forehead and extending back up.

name: Bench Dip
description: Dips with hands on a bench behind you and feet on the floor or an opposite bench.

name: Diamond Push-Up
description: Push-up with hands together under the chest forming a diamond, loading the triceps.

name: Cable Overhead Extension
description: Facing away from a low cable, extend a rope from behind the head to overhead.

name: Triceps Kickback
description: Hinged forward with the upper arm parallel to the floor, extend a dumbbell straight back.

name: Wrist Curl
description: Forearms on a bench, curl a barbell using only wrist flexion.

name: Reverse Wrist Curl
description: Palms-down wrist extension with a light barbell or dumbbells.

name: Reverse Curl
description: Curl a bar with a palms-down grip to load the brachioradialis and forearm extensors.

name: Farmer's Carry
description: Walk a set distance holding heavy dumbbells or handles at your sides with tall posture.

name: Plank
description: Hold a rigid forearm plank with glutes and abs braced; add weight on the back to progress.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
description: Hanging from a bar, raise straight legs to hip height or above without swinging.

name: Cable Crunch
description: Kneeling below a high cable, crunch the ribcage toward the pelvis against the stack.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
description: From the knees, roll an ab wheel forward as far as control allows and pull back.

name: Russian Twist
description: Seated with heels light or lifted, rotate a weight side to side across the torso.

name: Pallof Press
description: Standing side-on to a cable, press the handle straight out and resist rotation.

name: Side Plank
description: Hold a rigid side plank on one forearm, hips high; load with a plate to progress.

name: Weighted Sit-Up
description: Sit-up holding a plate or dumbbell at the chest or overhead for added resistance.

name: Dead Bug
description: On your back, extend opposite arm and leg while keeping the lower back pressed flat.

name: Cable Woodchopper
description: Rotate a cable handle diagonally across the body from high to low with straight arms.

name: Back Squat
description: Barbell across the upper back, squat to at least parallel and drive back to standing.

name: Front Squat
description: Squat with the barbell racked on the front delts, keeping the torso upright.

name: Goblet Squat
description: Squat holding a dumbbell or kettlebell vertically at the chest.

name: Leg Press
description: Press a loaded sled away on a 45-degree machine through a full but safe range.

name: Walking Lunge
description: Alternating forward lunges while walking, dumbbells at the sides or a bar on the back.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
description: Rear foot elevated on a bench, squat down on the front leg with dumbbells in hand.

name: Leg Extension
description: Seated machine knee extension isolating the quadriceps.

name: Hack Squat
description: Squat on an angled sled machine with the back supported, biasing the quads.

name: Weighted Step-Up
description: Step onto a knee-high box driving through the top leg, dumbbells at the sides.

name: Sissy Squat
description: Knees travel forward as the torso leans back in one line, deeply loading the quads.

name: Romanian Deadlift
description: Hip hinge lowering the bar along the thighs with soft knees until the hamstrings stretch, then stand tall.

name: Stiff-Leg Deadlift
description: Deadlift variant with minimal knee bend for maximal hamstring stretch.

name: Lying Leg Curl
description: Face-down machine curl bringing the heels toward the glutes.

name: Seated Leg Curl
description: Seated machine knee flexion; the hip angle keeps the hamstrings under a long stretch.

name: Nordic Curl
description: Kneeling with ankles anchored, lower the torso forward under hamstring control.

name: Good Morning
description: Barbell on the back, hinge at the hips until the torso nears parallel, then extend.

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
description: Balance on one leg and hinge forward with a dumbbell, rear leg extending behind.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
description: Upper back on a bench, drive a barbell over the hips to full extension and squeeze.

name: Glute Bridge
description: Floor bridge driving the hips up, optionally with a plate or barbell across the hips.

name: Sumo Deadlift
description: Wide-stance deadlift with hands inside the knees, emphasizing glutes and adductors.

name: Cable Glute Kickback
description: With an ankle cuff on a low cable, kick one leg straight back and squeeze the glute.

name: Reverse Lunge
description: Step backward into a lunge and drive up through the front heel.

name: Hip Abduction
description: Seated machine pressing the knees outward against pads to target the glute medius.

name: Kettlebell Swing
description: Explosive hip hinge swinging a kettlebell to chest height, hips doing the work.

name: Curtsy Lunge
description: Step one leg behind and across the other into a lunge, loading the glute medius.

name: Standing Calf Raise
description: Rise onto the toes under load with straight knees, pausing at the top and stretching at the bottom.

name: Seated Calf Raise
description: Calf raise with bent knees to bias the soleus.

name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
description: One-legged calf raise off a step, holding a dumbbell for resistance.

name: Donkey Calf Raise
description: Hinged at the hips with weight over the lower back, raise the heels through a long range.

name: Clean and Jerk
description: Olympic lift: pull the bar to the shoulders, then drive it overhead in a split or power jerk.

name: Power Clean
description: Explosively pull the bar from the floor and catch it on the shoulders in a quarter squat.

name: Snatch
description: Olympic lift taking the bar from floor to overhead in one continuous movement.

name: Thruster
description: Front squat flowing directly into an overhead press in one fluid rep.

name: Turkish Get-Up
description: Rise from lying to standing while keeping a kettlebell locked out overhead throughout.

name: Sled Push
description: Drive a loaded sled across the floor with low body angle and powerful leg turnover.

name: Burpee
description: Squat to plank, push-up, jump the feet in, and leap upward — a full-body conditioning staple.

name: Wall Ball
description: Squat and throw a medicine ball to a target height, catching it into the next rep.

name: Medicine Ball Slam
description: Raise a slam ball overhead and drive it into the floor with full-body power.
